description: Golden set of the skills policy (TD-058): nine cases replayed against the real model, outside CI. Rounds share one candidate and one offer; round 2 replays round 1 with an answered clarification.

candidate.title: Backend Developer
candidate.bio: Backend developer focused on Java services and data pipelines.

experiences.description: Java and Spring Boot services on MySQL; operated Kubernetes deployments.
Python scripts and Terraform modules for internal tooling.

clarifications.question: The offer requires Go; your profile does not mention it. Have you used Go professionally?
clarifications.rationale: Go is a required skill for this offer and it does not appear in the profile.
clarifications.answer: Yes: at Shopwise I built and maintained two Go gRPC services in production for 2 years (2022-2024).

cases.name: level -1
cases.why: Level band: candidate 3/5 against 4/5 expected, d = -1 -> 75.

cases.name: level -2
cases.why: Level band: candidate 2/5 against 4/5 expected, d = -2 -> 50.

cases.name: years ratio 0.5
cases.why: Years band: 2 years against 4 expected, r = 0.5 -> 55; no level stated by the offer.

cases.name: years ratio 0.2
cases.why: Years band: 1 year against 5 expected, r = 0.2 -> 30.

cases.name: related technology
cases.why: PostgreSQL absent; MySQL (same family) is proven by an experience -> 40-50, never a full match.

cases.name: bare mention
cases.why: No band; level unknown and only listed in the skills index -> 35.

cases.name: absent skill
cases.why: Go is nowhere in the candidate sheet -> 0 without evidence.

cases.name: silent offer, declared level 4 (TD-060 regression)
cases.why: No band (the offer states no measure); the declared level 4 is a known measure -> level-known band 4 -> 85, even without proven use.

cases.name: answered clarification as evidence
cases.why: The criterion states no measure and the answer states no level: no band applies; the answer proves professional use (two production services) -> level unknown but use proven -> 60, with the answer as clarification evidence.
